AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Demo banking app with mock data. Provides exchange rates, ATM/branch lookup, and opens secure screens for balance, card freeze and transfers. Operational Patterns: - Call 'findPayee' first to resolve a payee name to a payeeId before calling 'prepareTransfer'. - 'getExchangeRate' and 'findNearestBranches' return data that may be shown to the user. - 'openBalance', 'requestCardFreeze', 'showReceiveQr' and 'prepareTransfer' return a PendingIntent; launch it so the user continues in the app. Constraints: - Never state balances, transaction details or account numbers; this app does not return them to agents. - Transfers go only to saved payees, max 100 USD, and are always confirmed by the user in the app with biometrics and PIN. - Do not retry 'prepareTransfer' with a different payee if the payee is not found; ask the user instead.
